change.item: Shared CacheWriter now performs atomic tmp+rename writes for fetch and display-settings sync
Public widget cache JSON is written compact (no JSON_PRETTY_PRINT)
FetchCoordinator reloads the widget under the per-widget lock before fetching
Automatic fetch no longer updates modified/modified_by; runtime status is stored outside settings_json
Failed scheduled fetches apply exponential next_fetch backoff; manual Fetch Now ignores backoff
Cached images are keyed by URL + image-settings signature and reused before download
New remote image downloads are capped per fetch; scheduled runs use a wall-clock time budget
embed.script uses the same private/public Cache-Control policy as the iframe embed endpoint
Frontend widget CSS/JS moved to static site.css / site.js with CSS variables (cache-safe link tags in HTML)
Frontend render no longer re-sorts cached items (order applied once at fetch)
Domain registry retention cleanup runs on scheduled fetch only, not on public embeds
Replaced deprecated Application::$input usage with getInput() / controller $this->input
Removed PHP 8.5-deprecated curl_close() and imagedestroy() calls
Replaced GLOB_BRACE image-cache cleanup with DirectoryIterator for musl/Alpine portability
Reduced manual require_once loading in favour of Joomla NamespaceMapper PSR-4 autoload (safe module fallback retained)
External cron accepts X-DevArt-Cron-Token and Authorization Bearer headers (query ?token= remains fallback); invalid tokens return HTTP 403 and are logged without IP
Feed parser: RSS 1.0/RDF, dc:date, image enclosure / Atom enclosure / content:encoded images, Atom published vs updated, reject XML ENTITY, invalid dates stay empty and sort last
Central SettingsSchema contract for save, import/export defaults, public cache keys and renderer fallbacks
Shared Support helpers for layout aliases, feed-URL detection, HTTP(S) URL/IP policy and embed domain allow/block lists
EmbedOrchestrator consolidates iframe and script embed preparation; WidgetController responsibilities split into focused admin services
Widget edit admin template split into partials; tabs/picker/core labels and frontend embed status messages use language keys
Dropped unused #__devartrsswidgets_logs table (never written by product code)
Removed unused component Options cache_lifetime field (per-widget cache_lifetime remains)
Removed duplicate admin/script.php; installer script lives only at component root
Scheduled fetch due-scan filters next_fetch and cache_lifetime in SQL and loads scan columns only (not SELECT *)
Dev-only FeedParseTest covers RSS/Atom/RDF/XXE fixtures via PHPUnit
